name: VueNow Edge Data Centre - Ghaziabad
notes: Edge data centre operational in Ghaziabad (with Raebareli), part of VueNow's MoU with the UP government to build 750 edge data centres across the state by 2028. Capacity not disclosed (edge-scale).

name: UP Data Centre Park/Cluster - Ghaziabad (state plan)
developer: Government of Uttar Pradesh (InvestUP/UP Electronics Corp)
notes: UP government's data centre park/cluster plan lists Ghaziabad among 8 cities (Noida, Greater Noida, Yamuna Expressway area, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Agra); CM Yogi directed expansion of the cluster beyond NCR including Bundelkhand. No specific Ghaziabad site/developer named in these reports.

name: VueNow Edge Data Centre - Gorakhpur
notes: VueNow plans to launch an edge data centre in Gorakhpur (land acquisition completed, launch expected soon) as part of the 750-edge-data-centre network under MoU with UP government. Status planned/under development as of Dec 2024.

name: Bundelkhand Data Centre/AI Hub (region-level plan incl. Jhansi)
notes: CM Yogi Adityanath pitched Bundelkhand (Jhansi is the gateway city of the UP Bundelkhand region) as a data centre/AI hub targeting ~Rs 2 lakh crore investment; UP Data Centre Policy 2026 (unveiled 6 Jul 2026) offers extra incentives for Bundelkhand and Purvanchal. Regional announcement only - no specific project in Jhansi district named yet.
